name: endpoint-monitor
description: Orchestrates the backend API, BullMQ worker, and Vite frontend in one command.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently --kill-others --names api,worker,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:worker" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.db:reset: npm --prefix backend exec -- prisma migrate reset
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
